messages:
Jamie N.: Hey! New hire here — got my monitor today but the monitor arm's tilt mechanism is super loose and there's no USB-C cable with the dock. Anyone from IT/logistics who can help? :wave:
IT Support: Welcome, Jamie! Sorry about that. Can you DM the order/tracking number? We can open ticket TKT-5538. Meanwhile, try tightening the knob under the VESA mount (turn clockwise).
Jamie N.: Thanks — don't see any knob under mount, it's a 3-axis arm, not the standard one. Shipping label shows Luma Logistics, order 98012.
Logistics: @Jamie N. — we shipped a replacement arm yesterday, tracking 1Z999AA101, should arrive tomorrow. Can you confirm workspace location?
Jamie N.: Desk 4B, SF office. If the arm arrives can IT also drop a USB-C cable? I only got HDMI and power.
Jordan P.: I ran into this: arm's tension screw is on the underside near the pivot. If you use a hex key it's M6. I left a spare hex set in the 2nd floor supply cabinet.
IT Support: Noted. We'll route a spare USB-C cable and an M6 screw with facilities. Ticket TKT-5538 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-5538
Erin W.: FYI @Jamie — quick fix: on macOS System Settings > Displays, set rotation to 0 if the monitor is acting weird after re-mount. Also run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` to verify hub enumeration.
Jamie N.: Awesome, thanks all. I'll try the hex key and report back. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
IT Support: Marking TKT-5538 as in-progress. Please add photos to the ticket if the replacement doesn't fit.
Jamie N.: Photo uploaded to ticket. Current arm is missing the clamp washer; looks like a packing miss. 
Facilities: @IT Support & @Logistics — can you confirm spare parts pickup from SF warehouse?
Logistics: Yep, parts dispatched. ETA 24h. :truck:
Jamie N.: Great, closing for now but will re-open if replacement doesn't fit. Thanks everyone!
